page.overview:
Who is Pollux?

Pollux was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Pollux was present with Argus Veer at the Carthag ampitheater. As they observed a reenactment of the Battle of Windsack, with Veer asking why the Harkonnens celebrated it if they lost it. Pollux replied that there were disagreements on how the battle concluded and how was responsible for the destruction of a Spice Miners' Guild facility situated there. Growing irritated, Veer demanded to know why his Spice had not been delivered. They were surprised when it was not Vastari who arrived, but Valentin, who had been sent in his stead. Veer consumed the Spice, not caring for Pollux's question of whether the servant had delivered his success, causing him to calm down and fall asleep.

Pollux explained to Valentin that while they were mostly retired, they came when called by Baron Vladimir Harkonnen, as Veer's vanity would not allow him to refuse. He then stated that due to the many injuries that Veer had suffered over the years, leaving him in constant pain and beyond even the help of the Bene Tleilax. He elaborated that the pain would drive most men to take their own lives, but Veer was too vain to willingly die.

Vastari later arrived, causing Pollux to ask him what had happened to Valentin. Vastari was not familiar with the name, apologising for his lateness and explaining the reason for it. Realizing that Veer had been poisoned, Pollux found him dead.
